assertions.basis: 2022 papal decree as published by FSSP: liturgical books in force in 1962
2022 decree explicitly includes the 1962 Roman Missal

rules.institute_name: Institute of Christ the King Sovereign Priest

assertions.basis: Institute states it celebrates the classical Roman liturgy
Institute explains its exclusive Gregorian Roman liturgical use
Institute statutes cited on official site explicitly identify 1962 liturgical books
Official Society article on the Roman liturgical books followed by the Society
Official Society article explicitly identifying the 1962 Missal

rules.institute_name: Personal Apostolic Administration Saint John Mary Vianney

assertions.basis: Apostolic Administration's proper Roman liturgical use expressly established in the 2002 Congregation for the Clergy statement reproduced by its Oratory
2002 statement names the Missale Romanum 1962 typical edition for authorized celebrations of the Apostolic Administration

rules.relationship_note: Six source-ID-exact Oratorio Sao Jose ministries, including one multi-rite Maronite host; not a venue-wide rule or general Campos geographic inference.

release_conditions: Matches exact immutable CL2 frozen source_id AND existing physical anchor
Applies only to identified source ministry, never the whole church or other celebrants
Does not verify a current Mass, timetable, Una Cum, canonical status, owner, priest, papal commemoration or rubrics
Do not promote three conflicting research-to-app physical-group mappings without separate alias resolution
Show Rite and Missal prominently; source evidence and rule ID remain internal, not shown on church card
